title: Crisis at the Capital
subtitle: Moscow's evacuation emergency and simultaneous operations elsewhere.
author: R.G. Cruise
summary: The emergency in Moscow coincides with Romanian control of Odessa and the opening of the German Tikhvin offensive.
outlineTopics: The defeats of Soviet formations west of the capital.
The emergency reorganization of Soviet defenses.

Civilian reactions and efforts to maintain public order.
The German advance and the emerging limits of Operation Typhoon.
The Romanian occupation of Odessa on October 16.
The Soviet evacuation of Odessa by sea.
Romanian military operations and the role of the Soviet Black Sea Fleet.
The beginning of the German offensive toward Tikhvin on October 16.
The increasingly different operational situations facing the three German army groups.
researchStatus: Research brief. Full study and dated military reconstruction in preparation.

chronologyNotes: The Moscow evacuation decision was issued on 15 October; panic followed on 16 October. Romanian authorities took control of Odessa on 16 October; later massacres retain their own dates.
